verdict.rationale: The only calendar evidence is the changelog note that external AI apps can connect to Missive over MCP and act on your calendar. That implies Missive holds calendar data, but it says nothing about viewing, responding to invites, or creating events inside the client UI. missing for 10: documented in-client calendar view, invite RSVP from the inbox, event creation from the client, Google/Office 365 calendar sync details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
